==The Conclave of Mules==
[[File:Joseph-Benwell-Clark-Arabian-Nights.jpg|thumb|400px|A pack of mules lead a man to the Conclave.]]

Hex [[07.21]]

Connects to: 16.09, 16.16.04, 16.16.05, 18.26, 23.10, 29.07, 29.07.02 and 51.29.

Every year, the mules meet on this sparse field to discuss what they have observed in the Shrouded Lands (see [[horses]] for more on the unusually intelligent mules of Gore).
